lines: 1 Ai hei hyamthaymei khwan akhat swna
Kandih bamv ’thuic ruan lik nuh khwan ’thei,
Lauthwan riw phungcna ai samc ruan ni tuang e;
Maansei nunc khou ai zanghuay ni tuang e,
Kaniw lung changc ding khang.
Ai samc tat ni tuang e dih lev duipui guay,
Maansei lunghpui bamv kathuicna khou;
Lu khat suanna, pary raclouna,
’Chumhmei khang dingna, laanhmei ta ’phutluhna,
Ai tat ni, Ai tat ni, kandih lev duipui kathuic khou.
2 Ai hei swmthaymei khwan khat sw khwan ’thei
Mpwan ^&8 aswkaeng sw lana,
Lungh ryanra bammei nunc kai ta ai phu ni,
Kalingmei, swmloumei latkaeng phungcna,
Swmlou tat ni tuang e.
Ai samc tat ni tuang e meic lunghpui bamv ’thuic,
Kaidai kathuic khou neihlaa riw phungcna,
Ryanra bammei lungning kathuic khou,
Ngangcthau dat ngam khang ai ’chamlou ni tuang e;
Ai tat ni, Ai tat ni, meic lungc geihmei kaidai guay khou.
3 Ai hei theih makmei khwan khat sw khwan ’thei
Ai kandih samc ’kuay lik ni tuang e;
Ravguangc ta kalummei naipui bamv ’thuic khou,
Akhwan kauc ranvna, sat saengcna suan ni,
Neihla gaichamv lu hei.
Ai samc tat ni tuang e kalaanv swkaeng khou,
Ai dinc lik tat ni ’chuzaenghmei chamv hei;
Ryanramei lung tiineihlaalou ni,
Ai hei theih makmei khwan khat sw khwan ’thei,
Ai tat ni, Ai tat ni, ai tat ni kalaanv swkaeng khou.
